endorsements.name: Paul Such 0x222
endorsements.label: Playing with Car Firmware or How to Brick your Car
endorsements.description: A lot of papers have already been done/produced on hacking cars through ODB2/CanBus. Looking at the car firmware could also be something really fun :) How to access the firmware, hidden menus & functionalities, hardcoded SSID, users and passwords (yes, you read right), are some of the subjects we will cover during this short presentation.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 22
